definition.description: Compare acting now with a bounded study and a complete response to its possible reports.

definition.title: Assess the value of learning
definition.responsibility: Compare a best action now with finite study-and-response policies under explicit probabilities, consequences, costs and availability.
invariants: Probabilities are explicit assessments, never inferred from state counts.
Responses depend on an observable report, never the hidden state.
Study fees consume cash and are subtracted once from expected operating payoff.
Pure information value is reported only when the feasible action set is unchanged.
Reference records do not become accepted facts without an explicit declaration.
Recommendations are conditional risk-neutral monetary comparisons, not factual findings or permission to act.

caseDerivation: Priors cover every frozen module.state and payoffs cover every declared action/state cell.
Study inputs cover every declared study and every state/report likelihood cell, including explicit zeros.
Accepted facts use frozen typed attributes; optional reference records follow frozen module.recordTypes without becoming accepted facts.
Case inputs may vary cash, deadlines, durations, fees, distributions and declared sensitivity scenarios, not objective semantics or identities.
schema.description: This describes the installed validators and supported presence-restriction paths; it is not a complete JSON Schema.

structuralSlots.description: Declare beneficiary, common money/time units, horizon and the installed risk-neutral expected-money criterion.
Declare typed attributes that accepted facts can constrain.
Declare finite hidden situations with typed attributes.
Declare proposed learning identities and observable reports, including no-report outcomes where needed.
Bind business vocabulary, basis organization and report representations.
State the premises and conclusion boundary reviewed by people.

caseInputs.description: Supply a cash limit or explicitly omit the constraint with null.
Declare the source and scope of the assessed probabilities.
Supply a complete explicit state distribution.
Supply action deadlines and cash requirements.
Supply the complete operating payoff matrix.
Supply fees, durations and explicit report likelihoods.
Declare reviewed typed facts with their source.

responsibilities: Study comparisons against the best action now
Complete supplied decision basis and coverage
Case changes when comparison context is supplied

module.title: Assess a payment-terms test
module.description: Compare choosing a fundable and deliverable proposed growth commitment now with a nonbinding payment-preference test and a complete response to each possible signal.
module.question: Could a timely preference test improve the growth choice enough to cover its cost?
module.boundary: One nonbinding preference test followed by one complete proposed growth commitment. Customer orders, collected deposits, refunds and adaptive marketing campaigns are outside this model.

objective.beneficiary: The business funding and delivering the growth commitment
objective.horizon: The complete declared campaign and customer delivery horizon

assumptions: The prior and likelihood matrix are explicit fictional teaching inputs. A survey signal is an imperfect observation of a declared situation; it is not a causal estimate of additional customers.

Net contribution for each action and situation comes from the same pinned planning assessment: customer receipts less delivery expense and committed campaign expense. The test fee is charged once, separately.
The test accepts no payment, order or deposit and creates no customer delivery obligation. A paid pilot requires a different complete operating model.
All declared situations remain logically possible after every report, including an inconclusive report. Zero probabilities never waive funding, capacity or timing conditions.
Operating eligibility comes from current native commitment runs for acting now and acting after the test fee and delay. A profitable action cannot compensate for an operating failure.

The baseline is a complete no-expansion alternative. An expected-contribution preference is supplied only for this optional learning comparison; feasibility alone does not select a proposed growth commitment.
